survey: A handheld pocket calculator, floating as an icon over a yellow pi-patterned background and tilted toward the viewer at about three-quarter view. Main parts: (1) a rounded rectangular dark-blue body with a raised rim, a single solid shell; (2) a red four-cell solar strip set into the top edge of the face; (3) a grey rectangular LCD display set into the face below the solar strip; (4) a 4×4 keypad below the display. Three columns of cream keys hold 7-8-9, 4-5-6, 1-2-3 and 0-.-=, and a fourth column of cyan operator keys holds ÷, ×, − and a slightly larger +. All keys sit raised and evenly spaced on the face, so each could be pressed. Rows and columns follow the tilt of the body consistently. The calculator floats as an isolated icon object, which is normal for a card, not a support fault.
